Methodologically, the work integrates the dyad of states accompanied by defilement (*saraṇaduka*) with the triad of objects of consciousness that are limited (*parittārammaṇattika*), analyzing their conditioned causal interactions within the Abhidhamma conditional framework [SuttaCentral].
